about: Lays its entries out in columns, as a root holding items that may span more than one of them.

align.about: Where an entry sits in a row taller than it is: a short entry beside one that runs to a second line.
align.title: Alignment

counts.about: Every count, each drawing that many equal columns and wrapping the twelve entries into them.
counts.title: Counts

filled.about: The same measure filled rather than fitted, in the same three rooms. A filled grid shares out whatever the last row leaves over, so its columns stretch to the room's edge where a fitted grid leaves the remainder empty.
filled.title: Filled

fitted.about: One fitted measure in three rooms. A measure names a column's width, so what it decides is how many columns a given room holds: the same grid draws one column, then two, then three, as the room grows. Drawn the other way round, as every measure at one width, thirteen of the fourteen steps were wider than a card and each drew the same single column.
fitted.title: Fitted

flow.about: Which way the entries are placed: along the rows, down the columns, or along the rows with a later entry pulled back into a hole an earlier one left.
flow.title: Flow

gap.about: Every gap of the scale, between three columns of entries.
gap.title: Gaps

justify.about: How the columns share the room along the row. The columns of every measure fill the grid, so the shares read alike until a theme narrows the tracks.
justify.title: Distribution

note: A note that runs on to a second line in its column

span.about: Every span an entry can take in a grid of twelve, drawn on the first entry with the rest a column wide.
span.title: Spans

title: Grid
